data.name: Elhamra
data.gender_notes: Elhamra is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'El-Hamra', meaning 'The Radiant'. A beautiful and captivating name for a little girl that signifies her inner and outer beauty. The name Elhamra carries the meaning “Beautiful, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Elhamra usually hope their child will grow to embody beautiful, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies the presence of God's light and radiance in the child's life.
data.etymology: Elhamra belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Beautiful, radiant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elhamra total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: الهمرا
in_arabic.long_meaning: الهمرا هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من الجذر الهمر، والذي يدل على الحمرة واللون الأحمر، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الفرقان الآية 54، حيث قال تعالى: 'وَالَّذِي يَأْتِيكُمْ بِالْحُمْرَاءِ خَيْلٍ وَأَبْعَضٍ وَأَغْنَامٍ وَحَسَنٍ وَأَزْرُقَ ذَلِكُمْ رِزْقُ اللَّهِ وَهُوَ الْحَدِيثُ الْمُبِينُ'، ويعني الاسم الجمال والحسن، وغالبًا ما يطلق على الفتيات الجميلات صاحبات البشرة الحمراء أو الشعر الأحمر.

in_urdu.name: الہمرا
in_urdu.meaning: ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: الہمرا ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور حسن، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں بہت مقبول ہے، خاص طور پر پاکستان اور بھارت میں، یہ نام لڑکیوں کو دیا جاتا ہے جو خوبصورت اور دلکش ہوتی ہیں، اس نام کی تعبیر حمراء سے لی گئی ہے، جو کہ ایک خوبصورت رنگ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: एलहमरा
in_hindi.long_meaning: एलहमरा एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और حسن, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत लोकप्रिय है, खासकर भारत और पाकिस्तान में, यह नाम लड़कियों को दिया जाता है जो सुंदर और आकर्षक होती हैं, इस नाम की व्युत्पत्ति हमर से हुई है, जो कि एक सुंदर रंग है।

in_pashto.name: الهمرا
in_pashto.meaning: د ښکلا او معنی لرونکی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: الهمرا د عربي نوم دی چې معنی یې ښکلا او حسن دي، دا نوم په افغانستان کې د مسلمانانو تر منځ ډیر مشهور دی، په ځانګړي توګه د پښتنو په منځ کې، دا نوم نجونو ته ورکول کیږي چې ښکلاوې او دلکش وي، د دې نوم مطلب د حمراء څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې يو ښکلی رنگ دی.

in_english.name: Elhamra
in_english.long_meaning: Elhamra is a female given name of Arabic origin, derived from the root 'hamr', which means 'red' or 'beauty', the name is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Furqan, Verse 54, and is associated with beauty, elegance, and charm, in Islamic tradition, the name Elhamra symbolizes a person with a beautiful personality, a kind heart, and a charming appearance.

It is a name that resonates with the heritage of the Arabic language, which is renowned for its melodic and poetic qualities. In Arab cultures, names are deeply meaningful, often reflecting the character, qualities, or desires of the child being named. Names are also a source of pride, and parents may choose a name with a strong cultural significance to pass down to future generations.

The name is a reminder of the Divine Light that illuminates the universe and the unique spiritual essence of each individual. It is a name that inspires hope, joy, and a recognition of the inherent worth and value of every human being. May the little girl named 'Elhamra' grow up to be a beacon of light, shining brightly in her community and the world at large.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Elhamra is an Arabic name derived from the word "al-hamra," meaning "the red one." This name can symbolize the fiery spirit and passion within an individual, reflecting the intensity and energy that drives them in life. Alternatively, it can represent spiritual depth and resilience, as the red color signifies the strong, unyielding nature of the earth and the strength that lies within us.

historical_references.reference: Elhamra was the name of a significant fortress city built by the Almohad Caliphate in the 12th century in present-day Morocco. It served as an important political, religious, and military center for the Almohad Empire.
historical_references.context: Almohad Caliphate, Morocco, Fortress city, Political, Religious, Military center

historical_references.reference: The name Elhamra is derived from the Arabic word 'al-hamra', meaning 'the red one'. This name was given to the city due to its red-colored walls, which were made primarily of mud bricks and later coated with red clay.

trends: Gaining popularity in Western Muslim communities
